purpose: Prevent an older conversation or branch from building, publishing, or promoting an Android candidate after a newer Hakim development baseline exists.
rules: Freshness is evaluated at execution time, never from conversation memory.
A later-finishing older conversation never outranks a newer proven or developed version.
Before Android build, signing, publication, merge promotion, or field installation, discover the highest trusted remote versionCode.
The effective floor is max(field_floor.version_code, highest trusted remote versionCode).
If the working candidate versionCode is below the effective floor, stop before build/publish and rebase or port only valid changes onto the newest compatible baseline.
Never downgrade the installed field app to satisfy an older branch.
Never infer field acceptance for a newer artifact from an older artifact.
Do not change pairing, signing identity, permissions, or user data as part of freshness reconciliation.
